rules.statement: The interest of a deceased partner in the partnership assets passed to surviving partners by reason only of a bona fide purchase for full consideration in money or money's worth which was paid to the vendor for his own benefit, thereby exempting estate duty on the market value of the deceased’s interest in goodwill and other partnership assets.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that the interest of the deceased partner 'in the Reserve Fund and in the capital, assets and goodwill' of the partnership business passed to his surviving partners by reason only of a bona fide purchase for full consideration in money or money's worth which was paid to the vendor for his own benefit."
